title: TeSent: A Benchmark Dataset for Fairness-aware Explainable Sentiment Classification in Telugu

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual template-based testing by substituting male and female names and noun phrases into sentiment-bearing and sentiment-neutral Telugu sentences to measure Polarity Difference Score (PDS) and Equalized Odds (EO).

Counterfactual template-based testing by substituting Hindu, Muslim, and Christian names into Telugu sentence templates to measure disparities in sentiment classification using Polarity Difference Score (PDS) and Equalized Odds (EO).
